author: Arigenn
body:
Alright,

So I have recently gotten a plethora of messages from various players on Avicus, stating that they want something done about old throwback maps. Maps such as Teres, Fantasy, and Clay Wars were removed recently, or in the past, and many players are well..angry about this?

These maps were removed for a reason, and for most of the cases, it was because of these maps horrible gameplay. Now, can I propose that me and some other map developers took all the old MCZONE maps that you guys wish to return, and perhaps edit them. The following are a few maps that were discussed to be edited.

- Teres
- Ternio
- Dust Devils
- Clay Wars
- Fantasy
- Bleened Rings
- Halcyon

Post opinions on this topic below.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Teres - Remove diamonds & flamebows. This will mean much better gameplay. Possibly edit the back monument.

Ternio - Each team should be given 4-6 diamond blocks, no more than that or it'll be a kill farming mess.

Dust Devils - Monument location should be on too of iron.

Clay Wars - Monument location should be moved I guess. Wasn't much of a fan of this.

Fantasy - The land is uneven unbelieve, so it's unfair.

Bleened Rigs - Bring it back, no edits. Epic map.

Halcyon - Please please please don't edit it at all. It's really unique and I love it. If you really want to edit it, move the monuments back a little.

Thanks guys!

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Well... Teres, Clay Wars, Fantasy, Bleened Rings, and Halcyon aren't MCZone maps, but they still belong on throwback. 

For Teres, editing the map in it's current condition to make it smaller may prove difficult unless Howsie can do it or give us permission.

For Clay Wars, the original author said he was working on an update and that he didn't want us to make any revisions to it without his written permission.

Fantasy isn't really good either as a TDM or DTM.
Bleened Rings is alright, but not up to our standard anymore.
Halcyon is fine.

replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
- Teres: Remove flame bows, remove diamond. Give more blocks, and leather help instead of chest plate. I don't have a problem with the monuments on here, but a lot of people do. 
- Ternio: DO NOT EDIT; This was one of the best maps ever. If anything, give each team 6 diamond blocks, not more.
- Dust Devils: Make it CTW, and put the wool chamber on top of the iron. It would become of of the best maps.
- Clay Wars: Give full leather instead of misc, make a TDM version of this and make the monuments closer.
- Fantasy: Remove. Editing would take years.
- Bleened Rings: DO NOT EDIT. If anything, make the islands a little closer, like a block or two.
- Halcyon: DO NOT EDIT. Remove diamond and get an iron hub. Give more blocks and full leather with no iron pants. This has, in my opinion, one of the best monument placements.

replies.author: shoop_raton
replies.body:
I agree with Glitchy. Throwback is for nostalgic purposes and the games should last a while. Editing these maps literally takes the "Throwback" out of Throwback. If people don't like the gameplay on Throwback then go to a different Nebula server. The games SHOULD last a while, the old MCZone maps were made to last that way.

Basically if you were to edit the maps then they shouldn't belong on Throwback. Edit the maps and put them on a different server and then keep the original maps on Throwback so everyone is happy.

If neither of these points were valid or made sense, then I am questioning why you made "Throwback" in the first place. The maps weren't made to be edited, they were made to have nostalgic purposes towards old MCZone.
